reason: Pre-existing divergence surfaced by the leading-underscore call candidate (RFC 0106): `_addEventSubscriber` only now pairs with `add_event_subscriber`. subscriber.rb:94 `notifier.subscribe(pattern, subscriber)` passes the Subscriber object, which Notifications invokes through `#call`; the JS notifier takes a callable, so trails passes `(e) => sub.call(e)`. Same Proc-vs-callable substitution as the `log-subscriber.ts silenced? -> call` row. Language shortcoming.
